title: Promote a canary · 0 → 25 → 50 → 100%
provenance: Illustrative group changes, not a recorded Kubernetes run.
maxSurge 1 and maxUnavailable 0 per logical role. Starting groups do not provide Ready capacity.
The controller may combine changes or use a different safe deletion order.

primitives.text: maxSurge = 1 · maxUnavailable = 0 per role · Each square is one group
Commit templates B and the initial hold together.
Marker = requested hold · Bars show Ready groups, not traffic weight
Argo CD applies Git; LWS keeps the requested share.
Set 25%: start B in both roles.
Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups.
B becomes Ready in both roles.
Hold: 1 of 4 Prefill and 2 of 8 Decode are new.
Hold at 25%: check the engine before promoting.
Hold: half of each role is new.
Hold at 50%: the same percentage applies to both roles.
A’s last Prefill stays with its Decode.
One old group remains in each role.
B is fully Ready; A can now retire.
Complete: B serves the full desired workload.
100% completes the rollout; readiness and budgets still apply.

frames.caption: Argo CD applies Git; LWS keeps the requested share. Commit templates B and the initial hold together. canaryPercent 0; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 4/8 groups, 4/8 Ready. B: 0/0 groups, 0/0 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Set 25%: start B in both roles. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 4/8 groups, 4/8 Ready. B: 1/1 groups, 0/0 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. B becomes Ready in both roles. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 4/8 groups, 4/8 Ready. B: 1/1 groups, 1/1 Ready. Serving Ready 5/9; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Remove the replaced A groups. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 3/7 groups, 3/7 Ready. B: 1/1 groups, 1/1 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Start the second B Decode. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 3/7 groups, 3/7 Ready. B: 1/2 groups, 1/1 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. The new Decode becomes Ready. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 3/7 groups, 3/7 Ready. B: 1/2 groups, 1/2 Ready. Serving Ready 4/9; floors 4/8; requested 4/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Hold at 25%: check the engine before promoting. Hold: 1 of 4 Prefill and 2 of 8 Decode are new. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 3/6 groups, 3/6 Ready. B: 1/2 groups, 1/2 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Set 50%: add the next replacements. canaryPercent 50; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 3/6 groups, 3/6 Ready. B: 2/3 groups, 1/2 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. The new groups become Ready. canaryPercent 50; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 3/6 groups, 3/6 Ready. B: 2/3 groups, 2/3 Ready. Serving Ready 5/9; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Remove the replaced A groups. canaryPercent 50; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 2/5 groups, 2/5 Ready. B: 2/3 groups, 2/3 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Start the fourth B Decode. canaryPercent 50; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 2/5 groups, 2/5 Ready. B: 2/4 groups, 2/3 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. The new Decode becomes Ready. canaryPercent 50; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 2/5 groups, 2/5 Ready. B: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. Serving Ready 4/9; floors 4/8; requested 4/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Hold at 50%: the same percentage applies to both roles. Hold: half of each role is new. canaryPercent 50; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. B: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Set 100%: continue the rollout. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. B: 3/5 groups, 2/4 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. The new groups become Ready. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. B: 3/5 groups, 3/5 Ready. Serving Ready 5/9; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Remove the replaced A groups. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/3 groups, 1/3 Ready. B: 3/5 groups, 3/5 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Start the next replacements. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/3 groups, 1/3 Ready. B: 4/6 groups, 3/5 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. The new groups become Ready. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/3 groups, 1/3 Ready. B: 4/6 groups, 4/6 Ready. Serving Ready 5/9; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. A’s last Prefill stays with its Decode. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/2 groups, 1/2 Ready. B: 4/6 groups, 4/6 Ready. Serving Ready 5/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Start the next B Decode. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/2 groups, 1/2 Ready. B: 4/7 groups, 4/6 Ready. Serving Ready 5/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. The new Decode becomes Ready. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/2 groups, 1/2 Ready. B: 4/7 groups, 4/7 Ready. Serving Ready 5/9; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. One old group remains in each role. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/1 groups, 1/1 Ready. B: 4/7 groups, 4/7 Ready. Serving Ready 5/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. Start the final B Decode. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/1 groups, 1/1 Ready. B: 4/8 groups, 4/7 Ready. Serving Ready 5/8; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

Wait for Ready replacements, then remove old groups. B is fully Ready; A can now retire. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 1/1 groups, 1/1 Ready. B: 4/8 groups, 4/8 Ready. Serving Ready 5/9; floors 4/8; requested 5/9; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

100% completes the rollout; readiness and budgets still apply. Complete: B serves the full desired workload. canaryPercent 100; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 0/0 groups, 0/0 Ready. B: 4/8 groups, 4/8 Ready. Serving Ready 4/8; floors 4/8; requested 4/8; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.
